root_cause.text: The ladder governor assumes at least two idle states (states 0 and 1) and treats state 1 as the first usable state, but when only a single polling state (state 0) is registered, it passes an out-of-bounds index to cpuidle_enter_state, causing a NULL enter callback and system crash.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "the ladder governor may incorrectly treat state 1 as the first usable state and pass an out-of-bounds index" leading to "NULL enter callback being invoked". The patch fixes this by adding a bail-out in cpuidle_select() that returns state 0 directly when `drv->state_count <= 1`, bypassing the governor.
